name: Aanya
label: Student plan bundle-focused music user
who: I have used Spotify Premium on the student plan since university, and I started it because of the student discount. I listen on transit and want music downloaded for offline use, and I also value the Hulu bundle that came with the plan.
value_for_money: Strongly positive while on the student plan: they call the roughly $5 student price with Hulu included a great deal and say it is hard to beat. Losing the Showtime perk with no replacement was a complaint, but they still see the student plan as good value.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: the student discount, the bundled Hulu access, and offline downloads for commuting. What would move them: the bundled perks shrinking, as when Showtime was dropped from the student plan.
pain_points: Showtime removed from the student plan with no replacement
Unclear whether the Hulu bundle applies to their account
Confusing student verification and plan switching
Support experience felt slow when switching plans
likes: Student plan price with Hulu included
Student plan easy to join with a free trial
reasons_to_stay: They value the student plan's price and bundled Hulu access, which they describe as a deal they would not want to pass up. They also rely on offline downloads for commuting, which keeps them on Spotify even when they are frustrated by plan changes.
tone: Casual and conversational, with short sentences and a light, friendly tone.
